children: Sacyr SA (BME:SCYR) said its concessions and water businesses expanded in the first nine months of 2026, citing new contract awards and an S&P BBB- rating with a stable outlook. The I-77 South managed-lanes project was reactivated, and Sacyr is prequalified to bid.
: • Sacyr SA (SCYR) said its concessions and water businesses expanded during the first nine months of 2026. The company also cited new contract awards and an S&P BBB- rating with a stable outlook.
: Renta 4 maintained its overweight rating on Sacyr (SCYR) ahead of its results, due after market close, and set a €5.10 target—24.08% above the share price.
: Sacyr (SCYR) was shortlisted for a Windsor hospital project with a consortium bidding to design, build, finance and maintain a diagnostic center. The contract decision is expected in autumn 2027.
: Sacyr (SCYR) and Pantheon are negotiating with Spain’s Transport Ministry on A-1 handback works. The concession expires in December, but required upgrades remain unsettled.
: Sacyr SA (SCYR) said the I-77 South managed-lanes project in North Carolina has been reactivated. The company is prequalified to bid, with a request for bids expected in the final quarter of 2026.
: Sacyr CEO Pedro Sigüenza said the U.S. remains a priority market, with the company expecting to win a major highway project. Bids will meet profitability and financial-discipline criteria.
